    FAQ

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What cleaning services do you offer?

    Regular, deep, move-in/move-out, post-construction, maid services, window cleaning, Airbnb and vacation rental, commercial, event and after-party cleaning, and maintenance programs.

    Which areas do you serve?

    Boca Raton, Coconut Creek, Cooper City, Coral Springs, Dania Beach, Deerfield Beach, Delray Beach, Fort Lauderdale, Margate, Parkland, Plantation, and Pompano Beach.

    How can I request a free quote?

    Fill out the quote form on this page, or call +1 954 991 8282 or email info@maidinusacleaning.com.

    Do you offer recurring cleaning?

    Yes. Schedules can be daily, weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly, and one-time cleanings are available too.

    Do you clean both homes and commercial spaces?

    Yes, Maid in USA provides both residential and commercial cleaning.

    What information is needed to receive a quote?

    Your contact details, the type of service, the type and location of the property, and a short description of what you need. We can gather more details later.
